- @azure Rule - Use Azure Best Practices: When generating code for Azure, running terminal commands for Azure, or performing operations related to Azure, invoke your `azure_development-get_best_practices` tool if available.

For issue and pull request writing, follow `AGENTS.md` (Pull Request Writing and Repository Scope)
and the title convention in `CONTRIBUTING.md`. Use concise human-readable descriptions,
report checks actually run, and avoid agent-process transcripts in PR bodies.
